blocks.x: PlayStation Plus Makes 10/10 PS2 Remake Free For A Limited Time

Known as 'Cyberpunk 2077's' biggest fan, Angharad is a Welsh games writer who thrives in anything related to digital storytelling. If a video game explores the intricacies and horrors of womanhood, she is there.
Thanks to previous work at GAMINGbible, GameByte, The Loadout, Game Luster, Angharad has built a strong understanding of both the digital world and what fans want from it and is eager to share her thoughts and expertise with readers.

With Halloween just around the corner, there has never been a better time to get stuck into a classic survival horror game, and luckily, if you are a PlayStation Plus Extra or Premium member, you will be able to do so at no extra cost. If that still has not convinced you, you will be pleased to learn that the PlayStation 2 title in question just so happens to be from Konami, and you will be able to grab it from now until mid-October, giving you plenty of time to experience a classic gem.
Konami Returns With An Epic Freebie

If you have had more than a five-minute conversation with me, you will know that I am obsessed with the Silent Hill franchise, and so it is my absolute honor to announce that the hit Silent Hill 2 Remake is now free to download as part of the PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium tiers.

Launched back in 2024 as a remake of the hit 2001 survival horror game, the Silent Hill 2 Remake is considered one of the best remakes of all time courtesy of stunning work by Bloober Team and its publisher, Konami Digital Entertainment. Not only that, but with the original Silent Hill 2 recently celebrating its 25th anniversary, there has never been a better time to get stuck into its faithful remake. Of course, you could also check out the original, but with the original Silent Hill games being a nightmare to play on modern-day platforms, the Silent Hill 2 Remake is probably your best bet, especially as it is now free to download for a limited time.

Taking around 15-20 hours to complete, or a bit more if you want to chase that 100%, Silent Hill 2 is considered one of the best survival horror games of all, telling the story of James Sunderland who returns to Silent Hill after being summoned back by his dead wife.
The Silent Hill Franchise Continues To Shine

On top of the 25th anniversary of Silent Hill 2, just last week saw the release of the latest Silent Hill entry, Silent Hill Townfall, and so, if you experienced the latest that the franchise has to offer and yet remain a newcomer to the franchise, I would definitely recommend experiencing Silent Hill 2.

Unlike Silent Hill, Silent Hill 3, and Silent Hill 4, which are all connected in some way (although Silent Hill 4 is a lot more loosely connected), Silent Hill 2 is a standalone experience, with only brief Easter eggs pertaining to previous entries. As such, the Silent Hill 2 Remake is the perfect way to experience the franchise for the first time, especially as it features one of the strongest stories. Pair that with updated graphics, visuals, and performance, and you have the recipe for success.
So, if Silent Hill 2 Remake sounds like your cup of tea, make sure to take advantage of your PlayStation Plus subscription and download this absolute gem of a game at no extra cost this month.
M For Mature 17+ // Blood and Gore, Language, Sexual Themes, Violence
